name: Spiny Fiddlewood
desc: Spiny Fiddlewood (Citharexylum spinosum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 16 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Citharexylum spinosum is a species of flowering plant in the family Verbenaceae that is native to southern Florida in the United States, the Caribbean, Guyana, Suriname, and Venezuela.
